description: This file provides an implementation of a string-to-value mapping data structure, including functions for initialization, insertion, lookup, removal, and iteration. It leverages a hashmap internally and supports string duplication and memory pooling options.

methods.name: int cmp_strmap_entry(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for hashmap entries based on the string key.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * find_strmap_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Searches for an entry in the strmap with the specified string key.

methods.name: void strmap_init(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Initializes a strmap to an empty state.

methods.name: void strmap_init_with_options(struct strmap * map,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with specified pool and string duplication options.

methods.name: void strmap_free_entries_(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Frees entries in the map, optionally freeing only values or also keys and entries.

methods.name: void strmap_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Clears all entries in the map and frees associated memory.

methods.name: void strmap_partial_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Partially clears entries in the map without freeing the hashmap structure.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * create_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Creates a new hashmap entry for the given string and data, optionally duplicating the string.

methods.name: void * strmap_put(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Inserts or replaces an entry in the map with the given string key and data.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * strmap_get_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Returns the internal entry pointer for a given string key.

methods.name: void * strmap_get(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the given string key.

methods.name: int strmap_contains(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks whether a key exists in the map.

methods.name: void strmap_remove(struct strmap * map,const char * str,int free_value)
methods.description: Removes an entry identified by the string key, optionally freeing its value.

methods.name: void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t amt)
methods.description: Increments an integer value associated with a string key by a specified amount.

methods.name: int strset_add(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Adds a string to the set, implemented as a map where values are not used.

ctags.name: cmp_strmap_entry
ctags.signature: (const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)

ctags.pattern: /^void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap *map, const char *str, intptr_t amt)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void strmap_remove(struct strmap *map, const char *str, int free_value)$/
